evidence_note: Scenarios for future real-agent/Unity evaluation; existence and routing are statically tested, behavior is not.

cases.prompt: Dans notre projet Unity PurrNet, les clients spawnent des pièges sans aucune limite. Valide leurs spawn sur le serveur et refuse les prefabs interdits.
assertions: Inspect onClientSpawnValidate and TryGetRawPrefab on installed version
Reject unauthorized prefab, enforce quota and permissions on server
Handle partial SpawnPacket
Test rejection on remote client

cases.prompt: Un NetworkIdentity persistant DontDestroyOnLoad reste Not Spawned après changement de scène.
assertions: Check timing before network start
Check alwaysIncludeDontDestroyOnLoadScene rule and NetworkManager scene
Test additive scenes and deduplication

cases.prompt: Une référence SyncLazyRef vers un autre niveau n'est pas résolue avant chargement.
assertions: Explain GlobalNetworkID and deferred resolution
Check target spawned on assignment
Handle cleared/re-resolved on unload

cases.prompt: Comment retrouver tous les PlayerIdentity et TryGetPlayer à partir du PlayerID?
assertions: Check PlayerIdentity<T> API installed
No self-invented singleton player registry
Account for auth/scene ready and late join

cases.prompt: Network Visibility override ne masque pas tout mon prefab, certains composants restent visibles.
assertions: Observers are per NetworkIdentity component
Order of override in inspector matters
Whitelists, blacklists, parent and owner priority

cases.prompt: Je veux du ColliderRollback pour valider mes raycasts sur le serveur PurrNet sans PurrDiction.
assertions: Prefer classic ColliderRollback over PurrDiction lagCompensation
Check authoritative server and tick window
Do not trust client's hit declaration

cases.prompt: PurrDiction 1.4.0 PredictedIdentitySpawner nécessaire pour mes NetworkIdentity mirrored ?
assertions: >=1.4.0 uses automatic mirroring
Do not manually spawn/despawn mirrored identities
Prediction controls owner and observers

cases.prompt: Nous utilisons PurrDiction 1.3 et PredictedIdentitySpawner, comment migrer ?
assertions: Detect separate PurrDiction version before changes
Explain old component vs automatic >=1.4
Verify installed source not current docs blindly

cases.prompt: Implémenter HideFrom ShowTo pour visibilité prédite, sans Network Visibility classique.
assertions: Server-only predicted visibility
Hide whole root, ownership and ancestor exceptions
Scene predicted objects not affected in same way

cases.prompt: Le saut est perdu entre deux ticks, je lis GetKeyDown dans GetFinalInput PurrDiction.
assertions: Use UpdateInput for one-shot edges
GetFinalInput for continuous axes
ModifyExtrapolatedInput disables repeat
No input handler read inside Simulate

cases.prompt: Développe un contrôleur solo Unity hors ligne.
assertions: Do not force unrelated PurrNet guidance without project context

cases.prompt: Notre projet utilise uniquement FishNet et Mirror, pas PurrNet : configure NetworkTransform.
assertions: Do not hijack FishNet/Mirror-only work

cases.prompt: Le serveur dédié de mon jeu PurrNet démarre mais le monde est vide, alors qu'en host ça marche.
assertions: Skill auto-selection must be tested with actual agent
Review ObserversRpc server mutations and runLocally, not only connection status
